sounds.name: Whoosh, fast and soft
sounds.description: A quick, gentle puff of air with a soft edge and no weight.

sounds.name: Whoosh, fast and medium
sounds.description: A quick, clean swish of air with a defined middle.

sounds.name: Whoosh, medium and soft
sounds.description: A smooth, gentle sweep of air that rises and fades without an edge.

sounds.name: Whoosh, medium and medium
sounds.description: A balanced swish of air: a clear rise, a defined peak and a smooth fade.

sounds.name: Whoosh, slow and soft
sounds.description: A long, soft breath of air drifting past.

sounds.name: Swish, soft
sounds.description: A soft, thin swish: something light flicked past.

sounds.name: Swish, medium
sounds.description: A quick, clean swish through the air, with a little whistle.

sounds.name: Zip in, medium
sounds.description: A quick zip in: rising to a stop.

sounds.name: Swipe, fast and soft
sounds.description: A light, quick flick of a fingertip across a screen.

sounds.name: Swipe, medium and soft
sounds.description: A soft fingertip swipe across a screen.

sounds.name: Zoom in
sounds.description: Zooming in: air rushing nearer and rising to the moment it arrives.

sounds.name: Pop in, small
sounds.description: A tiny, bright pop that lifts as it appears.

sounds.name: Pop in, medium
sounds.description: A round, friendly pop that lifts into place.

sounds.name: Pop in, large
sounds.description: A full, round pop with a little puff of air.

sounds.name: Bubble pop, small
sounds.description: A tiny water-bubble blip, light and quick.

sounds.name: Bubble pop, medium
sounds.description: A clean bubble plip with a small one after it.

sounds.name: Pop out, small
sounds.description: A tiny, soft pop that drops away.

sounds.name: Mouse click, soft
sounds.description: A quiet mouse click, down and up.

sounds.name: Mouse click, medium
sounds.description: A natural mouse click: the press and its release.

sounds.name: Button click, soft
sounds.description: A gentle, soft press of a small button.

sounds.name: Button click, medium
sounds.description: A clean, crisp button click.

sounds.name: Tap, soft
sounds.description: A soft fingertip tap on glass.

sounds.name: Tap, medium
sounds.description: A clear tap on a screen, with a faint glassy tick.

sounds.name: Toggle on, medium
sounds.description: A switch flipping on: tick, then a bright snap above it.

sounds.name: Hover tick, soft
sounds.description: The faintest tick: a cursor gliding over something.

sounds.name: Letter key, soft
sounds.description: A soft keypress and its quiet release.

sounds.name: Letter key, medium
sounds.description: A natural keypress: the key going down and coming back up.

sounds.name: Typing, steady, short
sounds.description: A short burst of steady typing: a word or two.

sounds.name: Typing, steady, medium
sounds.description: Steady typing, about a short phrase.

sounds.name: Impact, light, on a soft surface
sounds.description: A light, muffled landing: something small dropping onto a cushion.

sounds.name: Impact, medium, on a soft surface
sounds.description: A soft, padded thud: something landing on fabric.

sounds.name: Impact, medium, on a firm surface
sounds.description: A solid knock: a medium-sized object landing on wood.

sounds.name: Impact, heavy, on a soft surface
sounds.description: A heavy, muffled thump: weight landing on something soft.

sounds.name: Impact, deep, on a soft surface
sounds.description: A deep, bass-heavy thud: something big landing on something soft.

sounds.name: Boom hit, soft
sounds.description: A soft, deep boom: a big drum struck gently in a hall.

sounds.name: Riser, 1 s, soft
sounds.description: A 1-second soft, airy rise that builds to its peak at the end.

sounds.name: Riser, 2 s, soft
sounds.description: A 2-second soft, airy rise that builds to its peak at the end.

sounds.name: Riser, 2 s, strong
sounds.description: A 2-second strong, bright rise that builds to its peak at the end.

sounds.name: Reverse whoosh, medium and soft
sounds.description: A soft reverse whoosh: air drawn in, building to a sudden stop.

sounds.name: Ding, middle
sounds.description: A small bell's clear ding (C, middle).

sounds.name: Ding, high
sounds.description: A small bell's clear ding (E, high).

sounds.name: Step 1 of 5
sounds.description: Step 1 of 5: a soft marimba note (C), each one higher.

sounds.name: Step 2 of 5
sounds.description: Step 2 of 5: a soft marimba note (E), each one higher.

sounds.name: Step 3 of 5
sounds.description: Step 3 of 5: a soft marimba note (G), each one higher.

sounds.name: Message arriving, soft
sounds.description: A little bubble and a warm note: a new message.

sounds.name: Attention, soft
sounds.description: A knock-knock on wood.

sounds.name: Success, soft
sounds.description: A warm, rising three-note marimba arpeggio: done.

sounds.name: Error, soft
sounds.description: A soft, falling two-note marimba: something's not right, gently.

sounds.name: Shimmer, short, soft
sounds.description: A short shimmer: a few soft, glassy glints that ring out gently.

sounds.name: Shimmer, medium, soft
sounds.description: A shimmer: a few soft, glassy glints that ring out gently.

sounds.name: Glitch, subtle
sounds.description: A gentle, clean stutter.

sounds.name: Glitch, clear
sounds.description: A crisp little glitch, stepping in pitch.

sounds.name: TV static
sounds.description: A burst of TV static: bright snow with a faint buzz in it.

sounds.name: Shutter, light
sounds.description: A compact camera shutter: a quick ka-chik.

sounds.name: Shutter, heavy
sounds.description: A camera's mirror and shutter: a fuller, slower ka-chunk.

sounds.name: Page turn
sounds.description: A page turning: lifted at the corner, swung over and falling flat.

sounds.name: Paper slide
sounds.description: Paper sliding across a desk: a soft, dry hiss.

sounds.name: Paper touch
sounds.description: A sheet of paper handled: a quick crinkle and rustle.

sounds.name: Count tick
sounds.description: A single soft, woody tick: one step of a number changing.

sounds.name: Count-up, short
sounds.description: A short count-up: ticks that speed up and settle, about 0.6 seconds.

sounds.name: Number landing
sounds.description: A woody knock with a small, bright ping: a number landing.

sounds.name: Logo sting, minimal, short
sounds.description: A minimal sting: two kalimba notes, rising.

sounds.name: Logo sting, warm, short
sounds.description: A warm marimba sting: a quick roll up into a rich, rounded chord.

sounds.name: Rumble, short
sounds.description: A quick low rumble, rolling in and away.

sounds.name: Rumble, medium
sounds.description: A low rumble of about three seconds: distant thunder, the ground shaking.

sounds.name: Whiteboard marker drawing
sounds.description: A marker on a whiteboard, drawing a few long strokes.

sounds.name: Pen drawing
sounds.description: A pen on paper, drawing a few long strokes.

sounds.name: Shimmer, short, sparkle
sounds.description: A short shimmer: a dense, tinkling sparkle, high and light.

sounds.name: Shimmer, medium, sparkle
sounds.description: A shimmer: a dense, tinkling sparkle, high and light.
